info.title: IPLocate Universal API
info.description: IPLocate provides IP geolocation and intelligence lookups, including country, city, ASN, privacy, company, hosting, abuse, and historical IP data.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: ips[]
parameters.description: Array of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses to look up in one request. IPLocate allows between 1 and 1000 items per batch.
